clear-wounds-on-full-heal.name: Clear wounds on full heal
clear-wounds-on-full-heal.hint: When a token's health goes back to maximum, should it fully remove all wounds?

token-images-are-circular.name: Token images are circular
token-images-are-circular.hint: Should the code spread wounds in a circle pattern? If you have square token images, toggle this off, so that wounds can appear everywhere on the token (in a square pattern) without always leaving empty corners. If you use top-down tokens you probably still want to keep this setting on.

custom-hp-value-path.name: Custom HP value path
custom-hp-value-path.hint: Advanced/unsupported systems only. If set, overrides automatic system detection: the data path (e.g. system.attributes.hp.value) to the actor's current HP. Must be used together with Custom HP max path.

custom-hp-max-path.name: Custom HP max path
custom-hp-max-path.hint: Advanced/unsupported systems only. If set, overrides automatic system detection: the data path (e.g. system.attributes.hp.max) to the actor's maximum HP. Must be used together with Custom HP value path.

custom-hp-zero-is-bad.name: Custom HP: zero is bad
custom-hp-zero-is-bad.hint: Only used when Custom HP value/max paths are set. Enable if a value of zero means the actor is in the worst condition (most systems). Disable if zero means the actor is undamaged/at full health (e.g. wound-based systems).

notifications.select-tokens-reapply: You need to select token(s) for the Reapply Wounds Based On Current HP macro to work.
notifications.no-tokens-selected-for-color-picker: No tokens selected, can't open blood color picker.
notifications.disabled-on-token-cannot-open-color-pick: Automatic wounds are disabled on this token, can't open blood color picker.
